message: Re-raise forbidden — convert exception to Result return

evaluator_config.message_template: Re-raise forbidden — convert exception to Result return

rationale: Re-raising is a declaration that the function chose not to handle the error. Under the Zero-Raise Policy, every function must handle its own errors. Re-raising violates this principle.
remediation: Convert the caught exception to a structured Result.failure() return instead of re-raising.

guidance.explanation: The correct version converts the exception to Result.failure(). The incorrect version re-raises, violating the Zero-Raise Policy by transferring error handling to the caller.
